function.name: investment_trend_analysis
function.description: Analyze the trend of a user's investment portfolio based on its history data. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

investment_data.description: The historical data of the user's investment portfolio.

time_interval.description: The time interval of trend analysis, e.g. daily, monthly, yearly.

display_graph.description: If true, generate a graphical representation of the analysis. Defaults to false.
